title.purpose: Wordmark, card titles, dialog headings. 16px is the ceiling — no display face above it.

body.purpose: Message bubbles, Ping content, transcript prose. 14px / leading-relaxed.

meta.purpose: Timestamps, footers, secondary chips, keyboard-hint emphasis.

micro-label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrows, state chips, provenance chips — the densest, quietest tier.

mono.purpose: Machine tokens ONLY — tool names, commands, ids, @handles, keyboard keys.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Almost-subliminal lift on cards, buttons, inputs. The foreground/10 hairline ring does most of the separating.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The floating scroll-to-end pill over the transcript.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Genuinely-above-the-plane surfaces only: expanded Tray panel, dropdown menus, discard dialog.

rings.name: card-hairline
rings.purpose: The ring-1 ring-foreground/10 hairline that lifts a resting card off the canvas without a shadow.

rings.name: focus
rings.purpose: focus-visible ring on every interactive element. Keyboard flows always show focus.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default color/opacity/shadow transitions on hover and state change.

motion.name: sheet-enter
motion.purpose: Side Chat sheet / rail slide-in (fade + slide-from-bottom, or slide-from-right on the desktop split) and the shell max-width widen.

motion.name: pulse
motion.purpose: Live status dots (agent working, running Process).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion is restrained and honors the reduced-motion query.

breakpoints.name: split
breakpoints.purpose: Side Chat becomes a right rail (was a full-screen sheet); shell can widen.

breakpoints.name: split-max
breakpoints.purpose: Widened shell max-width when a Side Chat split is active (900–1099 mid-width band).

breakpoints.name: rail
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop: the persistent 3-pane shell (nav rail ∣ chat ∣ context) engages.

breakpoints.name: shell-max
breakpoints.purpose: Desktop 3-pane frame fills to this cap, then centers.

components.name: Agent Message Bubble
components.description: The agent's turn in Chat: muted secondary fill, left-aligned, no avatar. Speaker is signaled by fill + alignment.
components.html: Spun up the monitor. I'll ping you if the deploy stalls past 10 minutes.
components.css: .ds-bubble-agent { max-width: 80%; background: oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border-radius: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-bubble-agent p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Owner Message Bubble
components.description: The owner's turn in Chat: filled indigo, right-aligned. The one place the brand accent fills a whole surface.
components.html: Ship it. Ping me only if the tests go red.
components.css: .ds-bubble-owner { max-width: 80%; margin-left: auto; background: oklch(0.55 0.13 264.05); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border-radius: 14px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-bubble-owner p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled indigo action (send, confirm). Quiet 1px press nudge; hover dims to 80%.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(0.55 0.13 264.05); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.05s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.55 0.13 264.05 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.14 264.05); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.14 264.05 / 0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Round, quiet icon action used across the composer and headers (attach, close, more). Transparent until hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Attach files"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m21.44 11.05-9.19 9.19a6 6 0 0 1-8.49-8.49l8.57-8.57A4 4 0 1 1 18 8.84l-8.59 8.57a2 2 0 0 1-2.83-2.83l8.49-8.48"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033 / 0.5); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.14 264.05 / 0.5); }

components.name: Ping Card (requires response)
components.description: A Ping that needs the owner: indigo left stripe, unread dot, bold text, hairline ring. Flat — no drop shadow.
components.html:
Jul 10, 09:24
Which staging DB should the migration target — stg-a or stg-b?
components.css: .ds-ping-card { position: relative; background: oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); border-radius: 14px; border-left: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.13 264.05); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.985 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); padding: 12px; font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ping-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-ping-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.55 0.13 264.05); flex: none; } .ds-ping-time { font-size: 0.7rem; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); } .ds-ping-body { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-mono { background: oklch(0.274 0.006 286.033); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 4px; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", "Cascadia Code", "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.8em; color: oklch(0.985 0 0 / 0.9); }

components.name: Timeline Tool Row
components.description: One tool call in the running turn timeline: state glyph, tool name in mono, muted result summary — on a hairline left rail.
components.html: • bash.runexited 0 in 2.1s
components.css: .ds-timeline { list-style: none; margin: 0 0 0 4px; padding: 0 0 0 12px; border-left: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0 0 / 0.06); } .ds-tool-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tool-ok { flex: none; color: oklch(0.72 0.185 150); } .ds-tool-name { flex: none; font-family: "SFMono-Regular", "Cascadia Code", "Liberation Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; color: oklch(0.985 0 0 / 0.9); } .ds-tool-detail { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Process State Chip
components.description: A running/failed/done pill: tinted-fill-plus-colored-text semantic. Running carries a pulsing dot; done stays quiet.
components.css: .ds-chip-running { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 1px 6px; font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; background: oklch(0.72 0.115 221 / 0.15); color: oklch(0.72 0.115 221); } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.72 0.115 221); animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.6,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

components.name: Composer Textarea
components.description: The message composer field: transparent over a white/15 hairline, indigo focus ring, auto-grow capped.
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; min-height: 0; max-height: 112px; resize: none; background: oklch(0.985 0 0 / 0.03); border: 1px solid oklch(0.985 0 0 / 0.15); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: "Inter Variable", "Inter", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.375; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: oklch(0.705 0.015 286.067); } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.62 0.14 264.05); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.62 0.14 264.05 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview: hirsel is a professional instrument, not a chat toy. It sits in the lineage of a good TUI — lash-tui, Linear, Superhuman — where confidence is carried by typography and spacing, never by decoration. The surface is dark by default and dark by commitment; the light token theme is carried for parity but never shipped. Everything reads at a glance: is anything blocked on me, what is my agent doing, and can I stay out of it. Density is a feature, not a compromise; the same information presents at phone width (a single ~560px column with shelves and sheets) and desktop width, where a persistent 3-pane shell (a left nav rail ∣ the center chat pane ∣ an always-present right context pane) fills to a ~1600px cap and only then centers. Monospace earns its place and only its place: tool names, commands, ids, and keyboard hints. Motion is restrained to state changes and honors prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, near-black base (oklch(0.141)) with hairline white/10 borders doing the structural work.
One brand accent — a muted indigo (oklch(0.55 0.13 264)) — reserved for interaction and 'attend to this.'
Inter (with cv-alternate feature settings) for everything human; a monospace stack for machine tokens only.
Flat by default: separation via hairline borders and a foreground/10 ring, not drop shadows.
Restraint as respect: muted for everything, escalation is rare and legible without relying on hue alone.

rules.name: The One Escalation Rule
rules.body: Exactly one color means 'genuinely blocked on you': danger red, and only on the Tray badge for an open requires-response Ping. Indigo means 'interactive / worth a look,' amber means 'transient hiccup,' but red is the single interrupt. Do not multiply reds.

rules.name: The Color-Is-Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: No state is conveyed by hue alone. A requires-response Ping also carries a persistent left border, bolder text, and an expanded reply input; a Done Ping dims to 60% and shows a labeled tag; a Process state carries its literal word. Strip the color and the meaning must survive.

rules.name: The Monospace-Earns-It Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for machine tokens only: tool names, commands, ids, @name handles, keyboard hints. Prose is never monospace, and a label is never monospace just for flavor.

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: There is no display type and no hero. 16px is the top of the scale. Confidence comes from spacing and restraint, never from a big headline.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a white/10 border before a shadow. Separation between siblings on the same plane is always a 1px hairline. A shadow means 'this floats above everything,' and most things do not float.

dos: Do stay dark. The canvas is near-black oklch(0.141); raised surfaces step up one tone to card/secondary. Ship dark; the light theme exists only for token parity.
Do separate siblings with a white/10 hairline border first, and a foreground/10 ring on cards — reach for a shadow only when an element genuinely floats.
Do keep indigo (--primary) rare and meaningful: interaction and 'attend to this,' nothing decorative.
Do reserve monospace for machine tokens and keep all prose in Inter.
Do make every state legible without color: a stripe, a dot, a weight change, or a literal label alongside the hue. Hold WCAG AA for body and secondary text.
Do keep motion to state changes — a pulse, a shimmer, a 200ms sheet slide — and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep 16px as the top of the type scale. Earn importance with spacing and weight, not size.
Do keep touch targets thumb-friendly on phone even at high density, and give every keyboard flow a visible focus ring.
donts: Don't build corporate SaaS chat (Intercom / Zendesk): no chirpy rounded-friendly bubbles with tails, no marketing tone, no drop-shadowed pastel cards, no 'How can I help you today!' energy.
Don't build a consumer assistant (Siri / Alexa / ChatGPT mobile): no mascot personality, no over-explaining, no empty enthusiasm, no hand-holding onboarding.
Don't build a notification slot machine: no badge spam, no scattered red dots, no engagement-bait urgency. One interrupt (danger red on the Tray badge) and silence otherwise.
Don't introduce a second saturated hue or a gradient. Neutral grays + one indigo + a tiny semantic status set. No neon, no glassmorphism, no purple-gradient dark mode.
Don't multiply reds. If more than one thing is shouting danger, something is miscoded.
Don't add a display face, a hero headline, or type above 16px.
Don't cast a heavy drop shadow on a resting card. If it looks like a 2014 app, the shadow is too dark and the blur is too small — use the hairline ring instead.
Don't set prose, labels, or decoration in monospace. Monospace with no machine content is costume, not signal.
